name: repo-graph
description: Local, offline repository intelligence for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Connect local repositories once, then ask agents normally.
interface.longDescription: Builds a local repository graph that coding agents can use to understand files, symbols, dependencies, paths, and change impact without sending source code over the network.
defaultPrompt: Connect this local repository, then use its graph to explain the codebase.
Use the local repository graph to answer this question in normal language.
Use the local repository graph before editing this repository.
